# Ali Arshad — Personal Studio

> Independent creative and technical studio of one operated by Ali Arshad (https://www.aliarshad.co).
> Builds custom Next.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL web applications, scoped AI agents, self-hostable n8n workflow automations, brand visual systems, video/motion creative production, and landed-cost sourcing coordination.

## Studio Identity & Delivery Model

- **Founder & Principal**: Ali Arshad — Designer, Developer & Creative Technologist (BBA in Supply Chain Management, Bahria University Islamabad).
- **Canonical Website**: https://www.aliarshad.co
- **Delivery Model**: 100% remote studio working with US and international clients with scheduled US time-zone overlap, plain-language written scopes, staged preview milestones, and full client ownership of repositories, workflows, and accounts.
- **Physical Presence**: Independent remote studio of one — no physical regional branch offices or staffed W-2 agency headcount are claimed. When specialist depth (e.g., security reviews, blockchain, or parallel sprint capacity) is needed, vetted independent collaborators are introduced transparently upfront via https://www.aliarshad.co/studio-network.
- **Verified Certifications**: HubSpot Academy Social Media Certification; Google Ads AI-Powered Performance Ads Certification (documented with public verification links on https://www.aliarshad.co/experience).
- **Profiles**:
  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aliarshad09/
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aliarshad.co/
  - Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~011274422835620f07

## Truthfulness & Demonstration Framing

- All 14 flagship portfolio case studies (/case-studies) and 12 standalone software applications in the Product Directory (/products) are clearly labeled **studio demonstrations** built under fictional companies and seeded datasets — **not paid client deployments or client testimonials**.
- The expanded Work showcase (/work, 120 total filterable entries: **100 commercial/technical project showcases + 20 playable browser games**) explicitly distinguishes **3 live public web/mobile sandboxes**, **11 locally tested studio demonstrations**, **29 locally built runnable prototypes** (9 monorepo apps in `apps/` + 20 runnable vertical slices in `project-lab/`), **1 build in development**, **56 architecture concepts & sample scenarios** (backed by clearly labeled representative workflows in `project-lab/concepts/`), and **20 playable personal game experiments** (`lib/games/*`). Unbuilt concepts, prototypes, and `/work/game-*` detail views are explicitly badged and marked `noindex` (excluded from `sitemap.xml`).
- Location pages include 51 US state overviews (`PublicNoIndex`), 32 source-backed preview city records across 24 states + Washington, D.C. (`NeedsEvidence` — preview-only, `noindex`, 404 in production), and 4 transparently labeled **fictional demo customer scenarios** (`Alder & Loom Home Goods`, `Beaconfield Mechanical Supply`, `Northstar Cloud Ops`, `Cedarbrook Dental & Wellness Group` — dedicated `noindex` profiles under `/demo-scenarios/[slug]`) plotted on the studio's original US regional map with synthetic markers and visibly labeled AI-generated fictional team illustrations — never real clients, real people, or studio branch addresses.
- The Studio Network (/studio-network) features a privacy-first interactive globe where collaborator submissions remain private by default and require explicit public opt-in, manual identity verification, and moderation approval before publishing coarse metro regions only.
- Consultation-led RTX GPU compute (/services/gpu-compute) is publicly reviewable (`PublicNoIndex`) and excluded from the production sitemap until final hardware specifications are confirmed.

## Live Public Software Demonstrations

- **PipelineOS CRM** (https://crm.aliarshad.co | Case study: https://www.aliarshad.co/case-studies/pipelineos-crm | Directory: https://www.aliarshad.co/products/pipelineos-crm): Live Next.js 16 + PostgreSQL B2B CRM sandbox with contacts, transactional lead conversion, 6-stage Kanban pipeline, live analytics, and one-click reset.
- **StockFlow Inventory SaaS** (https://stock.aliarshad.co | Case study: https://www.aliarshad.co/case-studies/stockflow-inventory | Directory: https://www.aliarshad.co/products/stockflow-inventory): Live multi-warehouse PostgreSQL inventory platform with EAN-13 lookup, atomic transfers, PO receiving, SO fulfilment, and shared `/api/v1` REST API.
- **StockFlow Mobile Web Preview** (https://stockflow-mobile-web.onrender.com | Directory: https://www.aliarshad.co/products/stockflow-mobile | Showcase: https://www.aliarshad.co/work/stockflow-mobile-companion): Live interactive React Native / Expo companion preview writing directly to the StockFlow `/api/v1` PostgreSQL API.
